CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  NOTICE OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  ALHAMBRA PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  (NOTICE NO. N2M20-129)
  CORONAVRIUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE
Consistent with Executive Orders No. N-29-20 and No. N-35-20 from the Executive Department of the
State of California and the County of Los Angeles Department of Public Health Safer at Home
Order, the Alhambra Parks & Recreation Commission will not be physically open to the public and
will take place via video conference.
To watch and listen to the meeting: To maximize public safety while still maintaining transparency
and public access, members of the public can participate by using Zoom Meeting as follows:
Zoom Meeting direct link:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83642857267?pwd=NloraWtMM3p5dXpCeTBZL0NabWx2QT09

Meeting ID: 836 4285 7267 and Password: 920097
For those wishing to speak on an agenda item, please e-mail Maria Fregoso
at mfregoso@cityofalhambra.org prior to the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on and
your name. You should then join into the meeting
using https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83642857267?pwd=NloraWtMM3p5dXpCeTBZL0NabWx2QT09 with
Meeting ID: 836-4285-7267 and Password: 920097 10 minutes prior to its start time. Ms. Fregoso
will announce to you when it is your time to speak. You will have five minutes to speak, unless that
time is adjusted by the President.
As an alternative you can e-mail your comments by sending them to mfregoso@cityofalhambra.org
no later than 5:00 P.M. on October 1, 2020 to ensure that it will be printed prior to the beginning of the
meeting. Comments will then be read into the record, with a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per
individual comment, subject to the President’s discretion. If a comment is received after 5:00 P.M. but
before the conclusion of the meeting based on its time stamp, the comment will still be included as a
part of the record of the meeting but will not be read into the record.
Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated should
e-mail or call Maria Fregoso at mfregoso@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 570-5044 who will use their
best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations to provide as much accessibility as possible while
also maintaining public safety. Given the challenges of video conference meetings, all participants are
encouraged to e-mail their comments prior to the beginning of the meeting.
  Maria Fregoso
  Executive Assistant
Dated: September 24, 2020

   AGENDA

  Commissioners  Members Ex Officio

  Donald Mumford, President  Patricia Rodriguez-Mackintosh, Board of Education

  Bella Flowers
  Marisol Greer

  Maurice Norrington
  Anthony Seto
  Cecilia Talavera

  We welcome you to the Parks and Recreation Commission meeting.

  If you wish to address the Commission during the meeting, please complete a speaker’s card and give
  it to the secretary. The maximum time for addressing the Commission is five minutes. If you wish
  to address the Commission on an item which appears on the agenda, your comments will be heard
  during the Commission’s discussion of that item. If you wish to address the Commission on a subject
  which does not appear on the agenda but related to recreation or community service, you may make
  your presentation under Agenda item VI. Please be advised that the Commission cannot, under the
  provisions of the State of California’s Ralph M. Brown Act, take action on any item which does not
  appear on the agenda.

  When making your presentation, please give your name and address for the record, and make your
  statement as brief as possible.

  Thank you.

I.  Roll Call

II.  Flag Salute

III.  Approval of the Minutes of the regular meeting of March 5, 2020
  (only those Commissioners present at that meeting may vote on this item)

IV.  Tree City USA

V.  News & Events

VI.  Oral Communications
 VII.  Commission Orals

VIII.  Adjournment

  Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business described
  hereinabove are on file in the Department of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First
  Street, Alhambra, California are available for public inspection during regular office hours which are
  Monday through Thursday 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.

  Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior to the meeting
  described herein, he or she may contact Mr. Michael Macias, Director of Parks & Recreation, either in
  person at the Parks & Recreation Department or by telephone at (626) 570-5044.
